'''Tod al'Caar''' is a [[Two Rivers]] man in the army led by [[Perrin Aybara]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is very lanky with a lantern jaw.

== Activities ==
He was in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|6|55}} He accompanies Perrin into [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]].{{ref/book|7|27}} He leaves with Perrin for [[So Habor]] to buy some grain for the army.{{ref/book|10|25}} He carries the Red Eagle of Manetheren banner to the meeting with the [[Seanchan]].{{ref/book|11|4}} He goes through the aqueduct to enter the town of [[Malden]] before Perrin begins his attack.{{ref/book|11|26}}
